title: Model provider presets (contracts/providers/presets.json)
description: From API 1.51 (contracts/README.md, Model sources: presets). Not a message: the presets Admin › Model providers fills its form from. Studio embeds the file (gen/providers/) and serves it (GET /v1/studio/admin/provider-presets, openapi ProviderPreset is this item); the web never reads the file. Order in the file is the order in the picker (grouped Local, then Remote). check.py also checks: ids unique, a remote base_url https and not a literal loopback or private address, a server base_url's host host.docker.internal, a loopback or a private literal, and each preset as a body passes ProviderPut.

id.description: the provider name it fills; a remote preset's key file is named the same

models.description: the default list, the first is the default; a local server ships none (Fetch fills them)

key_secret.description: remote: the key file's name (required); a server preset has none

note.description: one grey line under the picker
